'''Sinoca Meeku''', also known as '''Sin''', was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Meeku was born into a family with a long history of working in the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunting]] profession. Though she mastered many skills of their trade, she opted not to pursue the family business and instead she ventured to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], intent on making a fortune on the property market. Over the next [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]], Meeku had several dealings with the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] criminal organization and she gained any appreciation for how she could further her business aims by working with criminal elements. Meeku was later among a band of Pyke-affiliated operatives who were assigned to track down the rogue [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Kaa'to Leeachos]] and after tracing Leeachos' movements through the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], they confronted him inside an abandoned annex of the [[NovaCORE kelerium processing plant]], in [[The Works/Legends|The Works]] region.<ref name="Under a Black Sun" />
